acceptance: `skill-sync.conf` pins the group containing `todo` to the catalog merge commit; the two other `rev` values are unchanged.
`make skill-sync-check` and `scripts/check_untracked_skill_mirrors.sh` pass in the worktree.
`rg -n "must not use the leader" .claude/skills` prints nothing.
The tracked mirror diff is limited to the two todo files plus skill-sync manifest or receipt files.
description:
Files: `skill-sync.conf` and the generated `.claude/skills/todo` mirror. The mirrored todo skill repeats the old ban at `SKILL.md` (Role boundaries in a batch) and `references/batch.md` (Roles).

Change. Set the `rev` of the source group that lists `skill = todo` to the catalog merge commit recorded on the umbrella. Fetch that commit into the local catalog checkout if it is absent. Run `make skill-sync` in the write worktree, then `make skill-sync-check`.

Decision gates.
- Do not start until the catalog text pull request is merged; pin only a commit that is on catalog `main`, never a feature-branch commit.
- If the regenerated diff under `.claude/skills` touches any file other than `todo/SKILL.md`, `todo/references/batch.md` and skill-sync's own manifest or receipt files, stop and report the extra files.
- If `make skill-sync` needs the `.agents/skills` materialization refreshed, let it; that directory is gitignored and is never staged.

Guardrails. The `shared-agent-execution` and `skill-sync` pins do not move. No hand edit under `.claude/skills`. Stage files by explicit path. The umbrella's guardrails also apply.
